tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yos lo snron zla'i nyer gcig nas tshes mchod chen mo sogs/ de rnams kyi chos spyod gtong deb bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ya/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan sa rta snron zla'i nyer gcig la gshegs/ yos lo snron zla'i nyer gcig nas tshes mchod chen mo 'di 'dzugs par mdzad pas/ de ltar na mus chen gshegs tshe 'jam mgon a mes zhabs dgung grangs nyer gnyis dang tshes mchod tshugs tshe so gcig tu phebs skabs mdzad pa'i chos spyod kyi tho nyung ngu zhig 'dug pa de la phyis su kha skong dang bstod tshogs 'phar ba rnams bsabs pa dang / sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros bzhi bcu'i lo sa byi nas bzung sngar gyi mang ja bzhi'i steng slar yang ja bzhi 'phar bas na de lugs kyi deb gsar dgos pa bzhin bsgrigs par phyis lha khang chen mor tshes mchod 'di rtag par mdzad pas/ de'i tshul ni snron zla'i nyer gcig gi nam langs la chos dung dkar po rgyang grags kyi gsung gis tshogs brda byung ba dang bstun/ nged rang / mkhan chen/ brgya las/ ban tshang pa/ chos grwa lho byang gi dge 'dun sogs mang ja 'du 'os rnams 'dus pa dang / khyams stod tshogs chen gyi zhal 'don rim par/ dkar chab skabs 'jam zhus la grub pa dang mchod/ bla mchod mchod pa byin rlabs ḍā dril rol chen dharmā ra ṇi tshar gsum/ skyabs 'gro gdangs ring ma rim pa gsum/ skyabs gsol gsum/ tshad med bzhi gcig sems bskyed gsum/ bla ma bskyed chog 'dren mchog ma'i gdangs ring thung las thung ba tshul pa'i deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du gsung ba dang ja dang po zhus/ ja mchod bskal bzang ma mjug gdangs ring bcas/ ja grub pa dang / brgyud 'debs nas bzung chos spyod yongs rdzogs la bar gdangs/ so so'i gdangs yod pa rnams ring ba dang / grangs gsog nyer gcig dang lnga brgya gsum sum brgya yod pa rnams 'dur ma mgyogs tsam dang slar nas grangs gsog rigs 'phar bar mi bya'o/

/gang ltar brgyud 'debs rnam dag mar sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rjes su rab mdzes ma/ shes bya kun la ma/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma/ grags pa'i mkha' khyab ma/ dkon mchog yongs 'dzin ma/ dkon mchog thugs ldan ma/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma/ ngag dbang lha yis rjes bzung ma/ lha mchog ngag gi ma/ ngag dbang zur phud ma/ skyabs gnas bslu med ma/ de thams cad shlau ka re/ slad nas kha skong 'dir 'phar 'gro zhing thams cad kyi rjes su gang zhig dad pas bla ma'i tshogs shlau ka gcig bir bstod a la la ma/ dad chu ma/ dpal ldan khyod kyi sogs/ rigs rus cho 'brangs ma shlau ka gnyis/ tshangs dbang ma/ khyod nyid ma sogs nyer gcig tshangs spyod ma tshugs pa dang / dang po'i gnyis pa zhus/ rdzogs pa dang mchod chab/ bsod nams dpag med nyer gcig byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs/ gung gseng / mkhar rnga 'dus nas/ srid pa'i khri shing nas srid bral ma/ chos rnams ma nyer gcig rgyal ba kun gyi sogs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sogs/ chos rgyal ma tshugs pa dang / dung mkhan bslang / shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i nyer gcig de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ sangs rgyas gcig bsdus ma/ grags ldan ma tshugs ring la ja gnyis pa'i dang po zhus/ nyer gcig rdzogs pa dang ja mchod phun tshogs gtsug nor ma/ ja grub pa dang skyabs gnas bzang po gdangs ma/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen/ g.yag rong rnams kyi sku bstod shlau ka re/ yon tan tshad med/ rab mdzes ma yongs rdzogs/ dus gsum rgyal mkhyen ma/ rigs gsum rnam 'phrul ma/ rgyal chen bsod tshogs ma shlau ka gsum/ dkon mchog gsum dngos ma shlau ka bzhi/ rgyal sras ngag dbang ma shlau ka gcig byin rlabs char med ma gdangs ma/ shes bya kun la shlau ka dang po nyer gcig yongs rdzogs gdangs ring thung / dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho gdangs ma/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma nyer gcig ma rdzogs tsam la gnyis pa'i gnyis pa zhus rdzogs pa dang ja mchod/

byams pa'i mnga' bdag ma gdangs ma tshugs pa dang chab/ rdzogs pa dang phan bde 'byung ba'i sogs/ gangs can bod kyi sogs/ mi 'gyur lhun po sogs/ gung gseng / dung mkhan bslang / mkhar rnga 'dus phral legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma gdangs ma dang gsol ba gdan non zhu/ grags pa'i mkha' khyab ma nyer gcig thugs rje'i dbang phyug ma/ sngags 'chang bstan nyi ma gdangs ma/ grags pa rgyal mtshan ma/ ngag gi dbang po ma/ grags pa'i mtshan can ma/ de ltar rtse gcig ma/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma nyer gcig tshugs tsam la ja gsum pa'i dang po zhus/ grangs gsog rdzogs pa dang / ja mchod rnam kun mchog ldan ma/ ja grub pa dang rgyal ba gnyis pa ma rang gdangs shin tu ring ba/ de ltar bla ma'i nas cung zad thung ba/ sa skya'i rje ma le tshan gdangs ma/ skye ba kun tu/ dkon mchog gsum dngos/ de lta'i yon tan/ dpal ldan bla ma'i/ brtse ldan khyod kyi rnams shlau ka re/ sngon tshe chos kyi/ mdo rgyud man ngag 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma shlau ka dang po nyer gcig dang / yongs rdzogs gdangs ma thung pa'i lha mchog ngag gi sogs/ gsum pa'i gnyis pa zhus/ ngag dbang lha yi sogs/ gdangs ma ngag dbang lha yi rjes bzung dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos shlau ka re/ gsum pa'i gnyis pa mchod/ ngag dbang lha yi mkhyen brtse ma/ gdangs ma tshugs pa dang chab rdzogs nas bdag kyang skyon bral/ khyad par 'khrul med/ ston pa 'jig rten rnams shlau ka re/ gung gseng / dung mkhan bslang / mkhar rnga/ 'dus nas rgyal ba gnyis pa shlau ka dang po nyer gcig yongs rdzogs gdangs ma/ lha mchog ngag gi sogs/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen kun ma nyer gcig 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs gdangs ma tshugs ring la ja bzhi pa'i dang po zhus/ 'khrungs rabs rdzogs pa dang ja mchod ngo mtshar ma gdangs ring ja grub pa dang / skyabs gnas bslu med shlau ka dang po nyer gcig yongs rdzogs gdangs ma/ 'gro la rjes brtse shlau ka dang po nyer gcig yongs rdzogs gdangs ma/

ma rdzogs tsam la bzhi pa'i gnyis pa zhus/ rdzogs pa dang mchod/ ring 'tsho'i bden tshig le tshan gdangs ma tshugs pa dang chab/ ngag dbang lha yi ti la sogs/ dkon mchog rin chen/ bla ma sku bzang / sku bsod ri bo rnams mdzad nas gsol chung la gyes/ dung dang mkhar rnga byung phral 'dus nas/ ji snyed su dag ma bskul ba'i sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang / zhes sogs la rol mo byas rjes/ mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ nas bskul mtshams bya dgos pas/ rol mo'i sbugs la yod pa rnams kyang gdangs yod stabs sgang dung dang por gsal mi dgos shing / gnyis par gsal byas la rol mo bzhag tshogs dpon gyi rdor dril las ḍā ma ru mi dkrol/ 'dod chags zhe sdang nas bskul la phyir bsngo'o bar/ ja lnga pa'i dang pos slebs kyang ja mchod 'chi med dpal ster ma'i skabs zhus la ja grub pa dang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas la chab/ ngan song gnas rnams ma lus stong par shog bar/ de nas dpon slob rnams bzhengs nas phyag 'tshal dang bcas thog ma med nas nyis brgya lnga bcu song rjes/ lus kyi las ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang / 'chi med lnga po sogs shlau ka re grub phral gral la bzhugs nas bdag gi dus gsum ma brgya rtsa tshugs phral lnga pa'i gnyis pa zhus la ji ltar rigs par mchod grub pa dang nas 'gyed brgya rtsa'i 'phros dang / skyes nas bsam bzhin sogs shlau ka gnyis po mdzad/ de nas bzang spyod rol mo can yan lag bdun ma rdzogs phral dung mkhan bslang / 'das pa'i sangs rgyas/ ngan song gnas rnams ma lus stong par shog bzang spyod ma rdzogs tsam la drug pa'i dang po zhus la ja mchod he ru ka dpal ma/ ja grub nas rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer la bsngo ba tshugs phral chab gtong / rdzogs nas gung gseng mkhar rnga med par 'dus nas/ gong bzhin thog ma med nas nyis brgya lnga bcu mjug gi tshigs bcad/ gsum dang bcas par phyag 'tshal/

gral la bzhugs nas bdag gi dus gsum brgya rtsa/ skyes nas bsam bzhin sogs tshugs phral drug pa'i gnyis pa zhus la ji ltar rigs par mchod/ de nas bzang spyod rol mo can/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas tshugs phral dung mkhan bslang / ma rdzogs tsam la bdun pa'i dang po zhus/ ngan song gnas rnams ma lus stong par shog gi rjes su ja mchod oṃ las ma/ ja grub nas bdag gi dus gsum ma brgya rtsa tshugs phral chab/ skyes nas bsam bzhin sogs/ sangs rgyas sku gsum ma/ ston pa 'jig rten sogs/ gung gseng / mkhar rnga med par 'dus phral bzang spyod rol mo can tshar gcig bdun pa'i gnyis pa zhus la yan lag bdun pa rdzogs pa dang mchod grub nas 'das pa'i sangs rgyas sogs/ bdag gi dus gsum ma yongs rdzogs gcig mchod 'phreng tshugs pa dang dung mkhan bslang / dus 'khor maṇḍal mi mdzad/ dbang bzhi gsol len gyi skabs ja brgyad pa'i dang po zhus/ mnyam bzhag grub phral ja mchod thams cad mkhyen pa sa skya lo tsā'i sogs shlau ka gcig ja grub pa dang thos rgyal ma'i dbyangs nas bzung gsang chen ma gdangs ma'i skabs chab/ bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog bar/ gung gseng / mkhar rnga med par 'dus nas bzang spyod shur ma tshugs pa dang ja brgyad pa'i gnyis pa zhus la yan lag bdun pa rdzogs pa dang / mchod grub nas 'das pa'i sangs rgyas sogs/ bdag gi dus gsum ma rdzogs nas bar gdangs gong bzhin/ mi mjed ma tshugs pa dang grol chab/ byams smon/ 'di ltar bgyis pa'i sogs/ 'gro la bde skyid ma gdangs ma/ smon lam bkra shis gdangs ma'i mthar nyin mo bde legs ma gdangs ring / tshogs dpon gyis bsngo smon bgyid dgos pa rnams ni mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis tshes mchod chen mo'i rim pa'o/ ༈ /yang dus phyis zla nang 'dir 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul kyang mdzad pas/ de'i lo rgyus ni/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug dgung grangs nyer gnyis sa phag mgo zla'i tshes bcu la a mes zhabs zhi bar gshegs/

lcags byi rta zla'i tshes gsum nas dgongs rdzogs rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod dang / ser 'du sogs tshugs te de'i bcu gnyis la dngos gzhi mdzad/ lo de'i nag zla'i tshes bcu gnyis la spur mchod/ dgung grangs nyer brgyad pa shing sbrul ngam rings nas sa chen gyi sku phyag 'byor byung ba dang / gu ru'i gsol 'debs bod khams bde ba'i dpal ster gsar 'dzugs dang chabs cig yab rje'i rnam 'phrul myur phebs kyi mchod 'bul tshogs chen du/ 'jam mang ja gsum bcas nyin gsum mdzad pa 'di deng sang mchod 'bul du grags pa'i thog ma yin pas 'di la gzhan thams cad dang gsol ba gdan non zhu mtshams bcas gong bzhin la/ tshogs dung nam zir rang rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma'i 'go'i dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs med cing mus chen gyi rgyal ba gnyis pa ma'i rgyun gdangs las gdangs ring med pa dang / 'dir dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma shlau ka dang po nyer gcig dang gdangs med yongs rdzogs/ gos can khyab gyur cig gi bar/ ja gsum pa'i dang po ja mchod bcas grub pa dang / de ltar gus pa'i nas cung zad thung du song ba gdangs med gcig ngag dbang lha yi rjes bzung dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos shlau ka re/ ngag dbang lha yi mkhyen brtse ma gdangs ring / sa skya'i rje btsun ma gsum gyi bar mar gdangs/ bdag la dmigs rten sogs shlau ka gcig nyer gcig ma rdzogs tsam la gsum pa'i gnyis pa zhus la/ rdzogs nas skye ba kun tu nas stsal du gsol bar/ gnyis pa mchod gu ru'i gsol 'debs bod khams bde ba'i dpal ster bsam pa myur 'grub ma gdangs ma tshugs pa dang chab/ rdzogs nas bdag kyang skyon bral/ khyad par 'khrul med ston pa 'jig rten/ gung gseng / dung mkhan bslang / mkhar rnga/ 'dus nas/ bsod nams dbang phyug gi sku bstod man gzhan gong bzhin la/ bsod nams 'od zer la bsngo ba med pas bdag gi dus gsum ma brgya tshar dang po tshugs phral lnga pa'i gnyis pa zhus la/

mchod grub pa dang brgya rtsa'i 'phros gsog skabs dung mkhan bslang / bzang spyod gnyis pa tshugs pa dang drug pa'i dang po'i dang po zhus/ phyir bsngo'i rjes su ja mchod he ru ka dpal ma/ ja grub pa dang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas la chab/ ma lus stong par shog gi rjes su/ sems can 'di dag thams cad kyang sogs/ bla med bla ma'i/ 'bad dang rtsol ba sogs/ gung gseng / 'dus nas phyag 'tshal gnyis pa nas bzung tshogs dpon gyi bsngo ba'i bar gong bzhin te/ a mes zhabs kyi dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul gyi rim pa'o/ ༈ /oṃ swasti/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi rgyal ba'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por nged rang dang mkhan chen ban tshang pa/ spyi chen/ lha khang chen mo nas rab 'byams smra ba gral rim gyi bshad las pa gnyis/ dkon gnyer lto zan bcas kyis bde mchog pho brang du dge rtsa dang rjes 'brel bla mchod rgyas par mdzad pa 'di rje btsun gong ma'i sku thog la yod 'gro yang / lo rgyus gsal ba ma mthong zhing / a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i chos spyod kyi thog nyung ngu de ltar na bla mchod bstod tshogs kyi thog mar sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbus bla ma rnams dang / gsol ba chos spyod kyang sa lo'i rgyun mdzad bzhin 'dug pas sngar srol bzang po sa lo'i sku thog nas dar zhing rgyas pa zhig yin 'dra bas/ de'i 'don cha'i tho 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa la gzhi byas 'khrul pa bsal ba dang 'phar ba rnams gtong rim du bkod pa ni/ zla tshes de'i nam langs la 'dzoms nas nged rang sogs kyis 'jim pa byin rlabs byas la tshwa par 'debs rin gdan sa 'dir sbyin bdag rus rten byung ba dang / 'dzin skyong gi phyir srog chags la ltos pa rnams kyi rus bu sbyin sreg gi thal ba bsres pa'i 'dam la bsre ru'i rtags bzung / gangs nyi shar phral tshogs 'don gyi rim par dkar chab grub pa dang 'jam/

bla mchod pa byin rlabs dharmā ra ṇi gsum/ skyabs 'gro gdangs ring ma gsum/ skyabs gsol gsum/ tshad med gcig sems bskyed gsum/ bla ma bskyed chog 'dren mchog ma gdangs ring tshugs pa dang / sātstsha'i par dang 'dam bskyed la tsha tsha 'debs pa dang chos spyod stabs gcig tu bya/ zhogs jar ja mchod bskal bzang ma 'jug gdangs ring / 'og nas 'byung ba'i brgya tshar rnams 'dud ma mgyogs dang / gzhan rnams la bar gdangs/ rang gdangs yod rigs dang dbyangs ring ba bcas lam 'bras brgyud 'debs dpal mchog ma/ bde mchog brgyud 'debs gang drin ma/ dus 'khor brgyud 'debs khyab bdag ma/ mgon po'i brgyud 'debs rdo rje 'chang dang ma/ yongs 'dzin gyi sku bstod rgyal kun rigs bdag ma/ glo bo mkhan chen gyi sku bstod bsod nams rab rgyas ma/ rje sangs rin gyi sku bstod sangs rgyas bstan pa legs 'dzin ma/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo ma/ zhwa lu lo chen gyi sku bstod rgyal ba'i ring lugs ma/ sa lo'i sku bstod rab mdzes ma'i gdangs 'di la deb gsar rnying mthun par legs bshad nor bu nas thung du gtong gsung ba yod kyang / da lta chos grwa lho byang gsung rgyun mthun par chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud la skul mtshams dang / rgya chen thos pa la bskul 'go mdzad pas/ de nas thung du gtong / bdag chen ngag pa'i sku bstod dus gsum ma/ tshe nas kyi rigs gsum ma/ 'phags chen gyi rgyal chen bsod tshogs ma shlau ka gsum/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dkon mchog gsum dngos shlau ka gcig dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung 'dzin shlau ka gsum/ spyan snga chos kyi rgyal sras ngag dbang shlau ka gcig sngags 'chang chen po'i byin rlabs char 'bebs ma gdangs ma/ lha khang chen mo nas mang ja byung na ja mchod he ru ka dpal ma/ ja gzhan byung na gang rigs shes bya kun la ma shlau ka dang po brgya tshar/ yongs rdzogs dbyangs dang gdangs/ chab gung gseng /

'dus nas bsod nams dbang po'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma gdangs ma/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma brgya tshar/ deb rnying na grags blo ba'i grangs gsog sngon dang legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma gdangs ma yod kyang / deb gsar na 'gro ba'i mgon po ma gdangs ma/ grags pa'i mkha' khyab ma brgya tshar yod pas 'di bzhin byed/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug ma/ sgar chen gyi grags rgyal ma shlau ka gcig sku 'bring gi ngag dbang ma/ grags pa'i mtshan can/ de ltar rtse gcig ste shlau ka gsum/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma brgya tshar/ rgyal ba gnyis pa ma gdangs ma/ spyan snga kun don gyi sngon tshe chos kyi ma/ mkhan chen ngag chos kyi mdo rgyud man ngag ma/ deb rnying na 'dir smon lam bkra shis dkyus bzhin gsungs pa/ deng sang 'og nas 'byung ba'i sa skya'i rje btsun le tshan sogs yin/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs shlau ka gcig a mes zhabs kyi 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma shlau ka dang po brgya tshar/ yongs rdzogs gdangs mar lha mchog ngag dbang dang / ngag dbang lha yi ti la ka mthud pa/ ngag dbang lha yi rjes bzung ma/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos ma/ ngag dbang lha yi mkhyen brtse ma gdangs ma/ chab gung gseng / 'dus nas bsod nams dbang phyug gi rgyal ba gnyis pa ma shlau ka dang po brgya tshar/ yongs rdzogs gdangs ma/ lha mchog ngag gi ma/ maṅga'i mtshan can gyi rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma brgya tshar/ 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs gdangs ma/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi skyabs gnas bslu med ma shlau ka dang po brgya tshar/ yongs rdzogs gdangs ma/ nu bo rgyan mchog gi 'gro la rjes brtse shlau ka dang po brgya tshar/ yongs rdzogs gdangs ma/ slad nas bstod pa 'phar na brgya tshar mi gsog go /sa skya'i rje btsun ma le tshan gdangs ma/ skye ba kun tu/ dkon mchog gsum dngos/ de de'i yon tan/ dpal ldan bla ma'i/ brtse ldan khyod kyi/ gdung brgyud bgres pa'i zhabs brtan shlau ka dang po gsum/

gzhan gang 'os gdangs ma gtong ba'am/ yang na bkra shis yon tan ma 'di da lta dang ma 'ongs pa bcas kyi zhabs brtan yin pas/ de kho na gtong tshe 'dzam gling byang phyogs sogs shlau ka gcig gsum/ yongs rdzogs gdangs ma/ ngag dbang lha yi ti la ka sogs/ dkon mchog rin chen ma/ bla ma sku bzang ma/ sku bsod ri bo ma/ chab gung gseng / 'dus nas bla mchod kyi phyi mchod/ dus 'khor maṇḍal/ maṇḍal so bdun ma/ gang gi mchod rdzas ma/ deng nas byang chub ma/ nang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/ phyogs bcu dus gsum ma tshigs lhug dbang bzhi gsol len gdangs ma/ mnyam bzhag thos rgyal ma dbyangs dang gdangs/ bla ma dang rang sems bsre ba'i mnyam bzhag dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i gdangs ma/ gsang chen ma gdangs ma/ skye ba kun tu/ skye ba 'di dang / bdag kyang skye ba/ dpal ldan bla ma'i/ sdug bsngal chu bo bzhi'i/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs/ yan lag bcu pa/ byang phyogs skyongs ba'i/ 'gro ba'i bla ma/ chab gung gseng / 'dus nas ja la ja mchod gang rigs/ gsol ba chos spyod la sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gdangs med gsum/ tshad med bzhi/ rnam dag chos dbyings/ ma lus sems can/ po ta la yi gnas mchog bcom ldan thugs rjes/ ji ltar bltams pa/ de dag sku la/ de nas de la/ mchod yon me tog shlau ka gcig phyag 'tshal ba dang shlau ka gcig byang chub snying po gsum/ rnam dag chos dbyings nas 'di bar gdangs med/ deng dus bdag tshe nas/ de 'byor shog bar/ lha dang lha min nas/ rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog bar/ sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rgya gar skad du nas/ yi rang gyi bar tshar gcig oṃ rje btsun ma tshar gsum/ yon tan mtha' yas nas/ rdzogs so bar gcig rje btsun 'phags ma nas/ chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol bar/ bla med bla ma'i/ 'bad dang rtsol ba/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che sogs/ sa lo'i sku bstod rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i/

rigs gsum rnam sprul/ rgyal chen bsod tshogs/ dkon mchog gsum dngos ma/ rgyal sras ngag dbang / shes bya kun la ma yongs rdzogs/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma/ 'dzam gling che dgu ma/ grags pa'i mkha' khyab/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ ngag gi dbang po'i nas bzung / rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog bar/ rgyun gyi gsol ba chos spyod bzhin/ skyabs gnas bslu med ma dang / 'gro la rjes brtse bcas/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs yan lag bcu pa byang phyogs skyong ba'i/ 'gro ba'i bla ma/ gsol ba mdzad ring rab 'byams pa rgan pas bshad pa rdzogs nas chab gung gseng / 'dus nas mi 'phrog pa'i sogs lam 'bras phyag mchod la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi nas/ chos 'bar la phyag 'tshal bar gdangs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs las nas gdangs med/ 'phags pa rin po che nas maṅga'i mtshan can bar gyi kha skong rnams chos spyod rab gsal par ma bzhin/ skyabs gnas bslu med dang 'gro la rjes brtse shlau ka re/ bla ma'i bstod pa rdzogs nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nas/ mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo bar dang / mchod yon me tog nas/ mnyes gyur cig gi bar gsol rting mar ja mchod oṃ las ma/ maṇḍal so bdun ma/ gang gi mchod rdzas mar dbyangs/ deb rnying las deng nas byang chub ma dang / bdag ni thog med ma sogs lam 'bras phyag mchod dang 'brel/ smon lam tshigs bcad rnams dang gsungs pas/ bdag ni thog med nas/ ji ltar bsngos pa 'grub par shog gi bar/ deng nas byang chub mar bdag ni thog med sbrel ba las maṇḍal gyi sngags dang / sa skya'i rje btsun ma le tshan mi dgos/ phyogs bcu dus gsum ma tshigs lhug dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che sogs/ thos rgyal ma gdangs med/ rtag tu mnyes gyur cig gi bar/ skye ba kun tu sdug bsngal chu bo bzhi'i nas/ myur thob shog gi bar/ bstan pa'i bdag po/ ja gtong / thub bstod sems brtse ma gsum gyi bar mar gdangs/

de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku/ khyed la bstod cing / byams dkyil ma/ gang blo ma/ deb rnying na brtse ldan khyod kyi sogs med pas gang blo ma'i rjes su phan bde 'byung ba'i/ dkon mchog rin chen/ bla ma sku bzang / sku bsod ri bo/ zhi ba gdong bzhi ma gdangs ma/ rin chen bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs bar/ deb rnying las rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang lo tsā ba gsungs pa 'di yin cing / rgyal mes dpon gsum gyi bstod pa mdzad gsungs pa deb rnying bzhin bcug na/ mi yi bdag po bod yul mtha' 'khob ste shlau ka gnyis sbyar/ bir bstod a la la ma/ dad chu ma/ dpal ldan khyod kyi/ rigs rus cho 'brang ma/ tshangs dbang ma gdangs ma/ khyod nyid ma gdangs med/ tshangs spyod ma gdangs ma/ srid bral ma gsum gyi gnyis pa dang gsum pa srid pa'i 'khri shing nas/ bskul zhing bar mar gdangs/ chos rnams ma brgya tshar/ rgyal ba kun gyi/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i/ shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i dbyangs/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs nyis btud/ chos rgyal ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs sogs/ 'phags bstod la deb gsar rnying na gdangs med kyang / sa byi nas bzung nged rang gis btsugs pa sangs rgyas kun gyi mar gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi gdangs gcug la/ chu skyes tshal rnams rgyas par mdzad la 'dud la skul mtshams/ chos rje nyi ma nas bskul la/ gdul bya'i bung ba'i legs par bstan la 'dud bar/ de ltar lha dbang nas gdangs med pa grags ldan ma/ skyabs gnas bzang po shlau ka dang po brgya tshar/ yongs gdangs ma/ bsod nams ye shes/ tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i/ mang thos nags tshal/ rgyal chen bsod nams lus stobs ma/ rab mdzes ma/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i/ rigs gsum rnam sprul/ dkon mchog gsum dngos/ shes bya kun la/ byams pa'i dpal mnga'/ grags pa'i mkha' khyab/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ ngag gi dbang po'i/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ sngon tshe chos kyi/

mdo rgyud man ngag 'jam dbyangs rigs thig rgyal ba gnyis pa/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse/ byang phyogs kha ba/ 'gro la rjes brtse ste bsod nams ye shes nas 'di'i bar thams cad shlau ka re re yin/ yon tan tshad med/ dkon mchog rin chen/ bla ma sku bzang / sku bsod ri bo/ chab gung gseng / 'dus nas ja la ja mchod gang rigs/ ngor bstod rba rlabs ma gdangs ma/ mus bstod thub bstan gser khang ma/ kun mkhyen go rams kyi rgyal chen bsod nams ma shlau ka gsum/ skye ba kun tu/ rgyal kun rigs bdag ma/ sangs rgyas bstan pa legs 'dzin ma/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ma/ zab yangs ma gdangs ma/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i nas/ rgyal sras ngag dbang ma'i bar gong bzhin/ shes bya kun la ma gdangs ma/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma/ byams pa'i mnga' bdag ma gdangs ma/ grags pa'i mkha' khyab ma/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug ma/ sngags 'chang bstan nyi ma gdangs ma/ deb rnying na re zhig rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma dang legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma mdzad/ phyis su sku mched gnyis kyi bstod gsar/ gdangs med re mdzad 'dug kyang / deb gsar gyi 'di legs pas 'di bzhin byed/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ ngag gi dbang po'i/ grags pa'i mtshan can/ de ltar rtse gcig sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ rgyal ba gnyis pa ma gdangs ma/ sngon tshe chos kyi/ mdo rgyud man ngag 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma gdangs ma/ rgyal ba gnyis pa ma gdangs ma/ sa byi nas bzung bslu med bla ma/ spyi bshags bcas gdangs ma/ yab rje'i sku bstod dus gsum ma gdangs ma/ rgyan mchog gi sku bstod gdung shugs mos gus kyi rang sgras gdangs ma/ ring 'tsho'i bden tshig nas/ snyan grags nam mkha' lta bu khyab pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog bar/ gong bzhin chab gung gseng / spro ja'i thog lcang gseb dkar spro bzhugs gral la rab 'byams pa gzhon pa'i bshad pa grub nas chab/ spro ja grub nas 'dus pa dang / dgongs ja la ja mchod gang rigs gsol ba thud sogs zhu srol 'dug

ltung bshags lus kyi las ni/ thog ma med nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang / mtshams med lnga po tshigs bcas/ tshigs bcad 'di'i mthar myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar shog mi dag 'gyur dag ste ltung bshags bton pa'i phan yon brjod skabs so/ /bzang spyod bar gdangs/ bdag gi dus gsum ma/ mi mjed ma'i bdag gzhan dus gsum nas gdangs/ byams smon/ 'di ltar bgyis pas/ 'di ma rdzogs kyang sātstsha theg bcad/ grol chab/ 'gro la bde skyid ma gdangs ma/ smon lam bkra shis bskor res kyi mthar nyin mo bde legs ma gdangs ring / deb gsar rnying na mi mjed ma dang 'gro la bde skyid ma'i gdangs/ lo re mos yin zer ba 'dug kyang dus phyis mi mjed mar mi mdzad cing / 'gro la bde skyid rgyun du mdzad kyang sa byi lo nas bzung gnyis kar bya zhing / dus phyis bsngo ba re mdzad srol 'dug pas/ de ltar na rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang thub dbang / sa lo'i dbu bla rnams la dgongs rdzogs mchod bsngo bya'o/ ༈ /oṃ swasti/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs 'di la 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i gdung brgyud srid mtha'i bar du 'byon thub pa zhig shin tu gnad che bas rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir/ las dbang gi rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud du skyes pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas zhal gro lha khang rten dang brten par bcas pa 'di gdung rabs rin chen phreng ba chu klung chen po'i rgyun ltar 'byon pa'i rten 'brel du bzhengs shing / gtsug lag khang 'og ma 'di nyid du shing bya 'go zla'i tshes bzhi la stong khun gong ma chen po'i rnam dkar phrin las las shar ba'i dkar dpyad ngo mtshar can sogs mchod rdzas rnams phul ba'i tshe gong gi zla tshes der gangs nyi shar tsam la gzhi thog pho brang nas chos grwa lho byang gi mchod phreng rgyas pa dang chabs cig mchod rdzas rnams drangs te lha khang chen mo bskor ba sogs bar bskor gyi rim pas zhal dro lha khang du phul grub pa dang bskor ba 'dus nas gzhi thog tshoms dmar bdag nyid chen po'i sku drung du chos grwa byang pas mchod 'bul smon lam dang /

lha khang chen mor ser ja'i thog 'dus tshogs kyis de bzhin mdzad cing / nged rang nas zhal dro gtsug lag khang steng mar sems bskyed rang gi blang ba sogs chos spyod mchod 'bul gyi rim pa dang / 'og tu dgyes rdor rab gnas 'bring po rnam sras bskang ba bcas nyin 'khyongs su sgrub cing / yang me phag lo'i chu bstod zla ba'i tshes bcu gnyis la gtsug lag khang steng mar ru thog rgyal po'i rigs lcam chos lung ma bskal bzang bde skyid bu khrid nas dkar cha sogs mchod rdzas phul ba dang chabs cig gdan sa gzhung nas kyang mchod cha bsgrigs skabs 'og nas 'byung ba'i mchod 'bul chos spyod kyi rigs bgyis shing / sa byi lo nas bzung ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar bdag cag gi ston pa lhums zhugs kyi dus ston bstan pa gdung brgyud sde dang bcas kyi sku rim du 'dzugs rgyu la spyir lhums zhugs kyi ngos 'dzin mdo sde rgya cher rol pa'i rjes 'brang pa bu sogs mkhas grub phal cher sa ga'i nya la bzhed/ nyi ma'i snying pos zhus mdo'i rjes 'brangs rtsis pa rnams chu stod nya la lhums zhugs 'dod pas 'dir phyi ma bzhin hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i sha mda' btang ba dang / zhal dro lha khang gi g.yab steng nas chos dung rin po che'i gsung bskul byung bstun nged rang dang / chos grwa lho nas mkhan rin po che/ spyi pas/ dbu chos/ byang nas/ brgya las/ ban tshang pa/ bde chen gling gi dbu chos rnams chos gos sogs gzab gyon dang / tshogs lcam mi dgos shing / 'dus nas ban tshang dbu byed che bas bskul la chos spyod kyi rim par/ thog mar sems can thams cad rtag par sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes sogs ltung bshags phyag 'tshal bcas la/ de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol nas/ thal sbyar tsog pu lus kyi las ni nas/ myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar 'gyur phyag 'tshal de 'dra tshar gsum bgyis nas gral la 'khod de dkar chab grub nas 'jam/

skyabs 'gro bzhi bskor chos spyod kyi dbu bzhin nyer gcig sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gdangs ma gsum/ tshad med bzhi/ rnam dag chos dbyings nas/ de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol bar/ chos spyod gyi dbu bzhin gdangs ma/ grangs gsog rnams mgyogs pa ma gtogs gdangs dbyangs yod rigs ring ba dang / chos spyod byings la bar gdangs bcas/ ji ltar bltams pa/ de dag sku la/ de nas de la/ mchod yon me tog shlau ka gcig phyag 'tshal ba dang shlau ka gcig sems bskyed rang gis blang ba'i tshig byang chub snying po gdangs ma gsum/ de'i cha lag rang gzhan dga' ba bskyed tshig deng dus bdag tshe dang / bdag gi de ring / sems bskyed bsngo ba/ byang chub sems mchog sogs shlau ka gsum/ ja dang po ja mchod bskal bzang ma mjug gdangs ring / mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab sogs lam 'bras phyag mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi nas/ mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo bar gdangs ma/ mnga' brnyes chos 'bar dang / mnga' brnyes khyod la dang / mtshungs bral khyod la dang / dpal du gyur pa dang / blo ldan dge ba'i bshes la dang / mthu stobs dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs rnams bskul mtshams bcas la dngos phyag med pa/ mchod yon me tog nas mnyes gyur cig gi bar/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che sogs/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi sku bstod skyabs gnas bslu med ma gdangs ma/ byang phyogs kha ba can phreng 'khor/ ja yod na ja mchod rnam kun mchog ldan ma/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma gdangs sogs rgyun bzhin/ skye ba kun tu dang / dkon mchog gsum dngos nas gnang ba stsal du gsol bar rgyun bzhin/ chab gung gseng / gtsug lag khang steng 'og na bzhugs pa'i bris 'bur gyi sku rags bsdus kyi bstod pa dang / grwa lnga sogs byings la lam 'bras phyag mchod kyi gras/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sogs kyis 'thus par byas gtong rgyu la/ rdo rje 'chang ni lam 'bras phyag mchod du 'thus/

rtsa ba'i bla ma thar rje dang / gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gnyis kyi sku bstod rmad byung ma dang / dpal drug ma so so nas phreng 'khor/ ja byung na ja mchod thabs mkhas thugs rje nas/ shākya'i rgyal po'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul/ sman bla dang / thub dbang gnyis 'das pa dang da lta'i dbang du btang na gral rim gong bzhin yin kyang bka' drin gyi sgo nas thub dbang sngon la 'gro la dgos pas/ sems brtse ma gsum gyi bar mar gdangs/ thabs mkhas thugs ma dang / thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i gnyis so so nas tshar gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku sogs/ khyed la bstod cing sogs/ byams dkyil ma gsum/ gang blo ma gsum/ brtse ldan khyed kyi sogs gnas brtan phyag mchod gdangs ma/ mtshungs med blta bas nas/ mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo la bskul mtshams/ sangs rgyas sprul pa nas/ yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog bar gdangs/ ja byung na ja mchod dus gsum rgyal ba rgyal sras nas gnas brtan chen po rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ o ḍi ya nar sogs phur pa'i brgyud 'debs nas 'byung ba mjug bsgyur ba de dang / 'dzam bu gling du bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs sogs maṇḍal bzhi chog nas 'byung ba de gnyis so so nas tshar gsum/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs mkhan slob gnyis las thog snga ba'ang kha shas yod kyang chos kyi gtong mtshams bde ba'i phyir/ zhi ba gdong bzhi ma 'dir gtong rgyu la/ tshes bzhi'i deb rnying las/ lo tsā ba dang rgyal mes dpon gsum gyi bstod pa rnams mdzad gsungs pas/ lo tsā ba ni rin bzang gi bstod pa de ka yin cing / de'i rjes su mi yi bdag po dang / bod yul mtha' 'khob sogs shlau ka gnyis sbyar/ a la la te ma/ dpal ldan khyed kyi sogs/ rang don yal ba sogs/ maṇḍal bzhi chog nas 'byung ba de tshar gsum/ rigs rus cho 'brang nas chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs bar sbrel la tshar gsum/ tshangs dbang ma dang /

tshangs spyod gnyis gdangs ma/ srid bral ma gsum gyi bar mar gdangs/ chos rnams ma brgya tshar/ rgyal ba kun gyi/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i/ ja byung na ja mchod phun tshogs gtsug nor ma/ chab gung gseng / chos rgyal ma dbyangs/ 'phags bstod la sngar nas gdangs mdzad srol mi 'dug kyang / gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi gdangs ma/ chu skyes tshal rnams rgyas par mdzad la 'dud la bskul mtshams/ chos rje nyi ma nas bskul la/ gdul bya'i bung bas legs par bsten la 'dud bar/ de ltar lha dbang nas gdangs med pa/ skyabs gnas bzang po shlau ka dang po brgya tshar/ yongs rdzogs gdangs ma/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen g.yag rong rnams kyi bstod pa shlau ka re/ ja byung na ja mchod he ru ka/ bdud dpung 'joms mdzad nas/ thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs bar tshar gsum/ g.yag rong / grub chen/ ngor rnams thog mtshungs/ spangs rtogs mnyam pas gral rim 'di la 'gal ba med/ ngor bstod rba rlabs ma/ thub bstan gser khang ma/ rgyal chen bsod nams ma shlau ka gcig rgyal kun rigs bdag ma/ bsod nams rab rgyas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa legs 'dzin dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo/ rgyal ba'i ring lugs/ rab mdzes ma gdangs ma la/ rgyal chen thos pas nas thung du song ba/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i/ rigs gsum rnam sprul/ rgyal chen bsod tshogs las/ dkon mchog gsum dngos ma/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung 'dzin sogs/ rgyal sras ngag gi sogs/ chab gung gseng / shes bya kun la ma phreng 'khor/ byin rlabs char 'bebs ma gdangs ma sogs rgyun bzhin/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma/ byams pa'i mnga' bdag ma gdangs ma/ ja byung na ja mchod sa chen bla ma nas 'phags pa rin po che'i bar/ gong ma rnam lnga'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul/ grags pa'i mkha' khyab ma/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug ma/ sngags 'chang bstan nyi ma/ grags pa blo gros zhabs la gsol ba 'debs nyis btud yod pa bzhin gyi gdangs/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/

ngag gi dbang po'i/ grags pa'i mtshan can/ de ltar rtse gcig sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ rgyal ba gnyis pa ma gdangs ma/ sngon tshe chos kyi rgyal po/ mdo rgyud man ngag 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma shlau ka dang po phreng 'khor/ ja byung na ja mchod oṃ las ma/ gong 'phros yongs rdzogs gdangs ma/ lha mchog ngag dbang dang / ngag dbang lha yi ti la ka mthud pa/ ngag dbang lha yis rjes bzung / 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos/ ngag dbang lha yi mkhyen brtse gdangs ma/ chab gung gseng / rgyal ba gnyis pa lha mchog ngag gi ja byung na ja mchod ngo 'tshar ma/ 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs/ bslu med bla ma sogs sngon 'gro'i spyi bshags spyi smon gdangs ma/ 'gro la rjes brtse/ yon tan tshad med/ ring 'tsho'i bden tshig mjug gi tshigs bcad bcas rgyun gyi bla mchod bzhin/ chab gsol ba la de'i nye skor du gyes nas dung byung bstun 'dus la gos zung bkyed/ oṃ badzra yakṣa sogs mchod pa byin brlabs kun rig bzhin mchod yon phal cher ma gdangs ma'i rol mo dang / 'dod yon lnga'i sgra la tshogs dpon gyis rdor dril dang / de'i 'og mas ting shags/ dbu mdzad sogs gzhan gyis rol sil rnga dung bsgrags/ reg bya la gos bzung 'bul tshul/ 'dod yon gyi 'gor rgyal srid sna bdun bcas 'di'i tshig rnams chos spyod rab gsal nas 'byung ba bzhin/ ja byung na ja mchod 'chi med dpal ster ma/ maṇḍal so bdun mar phyag rgya/ gang gi mchod rdzas mar dbyangs/ deng nas byang chub ma gdangs med sngags bcas/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma le tshan gdangs ma/ bdag ni thog med ma/ phyogs bcu dus gsum ma tshigs lhug ja byung na ja mchod shes bya kun la ngag gi dpal ldan rtsa ba'i nas/ rtag tu mnyes gyur cig gi bar dbyangs/ skye ba kun tu/ sdug bsngal chu bo/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs yan lag bdun pa/ bstan pa'i bdag po/ chab gung gseng / bsam pa myur 'grub ma yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig gi bar gdangs ma/

po ta la yi gnas mchog nas/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog gi bar dang / ja byung na ja mchod skye ba du mar/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar bdun/ lha mo la gus/ rje btsun 'phags ma/ rje btsun bcom ldan nas/ chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol bar/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra bsam brjod med shlau ka gcig 'di skad bdag gis sogs mdo tshar gsum/ bden brdar gyi bzlog pa dgu tshar/ gang gi rten cing sogs/ thabs dang skyabs dang sogs/ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i sogs/ skar mda' ltung dang sogs/ glo bur ye 'brog sogs/ dus min 'chi ba sogs/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sogs/ gzhan yang skye ba sogs/ chos mthun 'byor pa'i sogs/ gtsug gi nor bu sogs/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang sogs/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs shlau ka gcig tshe gzungs nyer gcig tshe dpag med mgon khyed sku sogs/ khyed la bstod cing sogs/ phan bde 'byung ba'i/ chos rnga chen po'i/ dkon mchog rin chen/ bla ma sku bzang / rgyal dang rgyal sras/ gdul bya'i 'dren pa/ sems can 'di dag dpon slob mi 'bral sogs/ chab gung gseng / bzang spyod tshar gsum/ mchod rol bgyid rgyur/ mchod par bgyis la rol mo bkrol nas/ na bza' dam pa dang mchod pa gang rnams kyi shlau ka gnyis rol mo'i sbugs la brjod/ sgang dung tshar gnyis rol mo bzhag nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang nas bskul/ gsum ka'i mjug la bdag gi dus gsum ma re/ bzang spyod skabs ja byung na ja mchod mdor na mchod pa'i dang / bzang spyod bdag gi dus gsum ma bcas gsum pa rdzogs pa dang / chab gung gseng / mi mjed ma'i bdag gzhan dus gsum nas gdangs ma/ ja byung na ja mchod sngon tshe/ grol chab/ byams smon/ 'gro la bde skyid ma gdangs ma/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu sogs/ bstan pa bstan 'dzin spyi bye brag rgyas pa'i smon lam bkra shis nas bzung nyin mo bde legs ma gdangs ring gi bar bya'o/

/'di skabs su dgos pa'i chos spyod kha 'thor ba ni/ rmad byung blo gros nam mkha'i khyon yangs por/ /thugs rje'i chu 'dzin dpal gyis cher bltams shing / /bsam yas phrin las bzang po'i char rgyun gyis/ /thar pa'i 'bras ster mkhas grub la phyag 'tshal/ /ngag la dbang bsgyur kun dga' legs pa'i dpal/ /dpal gyi 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i dpal/ /dpal mchog mi mthun las rgyal dge mtshan dpal/ /dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /o ḍi ya nar rgyal po'i rigs 'khrungs shing / /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir ma rung kun btul nas/ /dpag yas byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs pa/ /padma 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dzam bu gling du bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs/ /kha ba can 'dir chos kyi sgron me sbar/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras kyi gtso/ /mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang don yal bar dor nas gzhan gyi don/ /lhur mdzad de ni gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal/ /dngos sam brgyud pas gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan a ti sha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud dpung 'joms mdzad smug nag khro bo'i sku/ /lta ba'i gdengs ldan brtul zhugs spyod pa skyong / /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon/ /u rgyan lung bstan skyes mchog sprul pa'i sku/ /thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ ༈ /na ma shrī wan saṅgu ru a nan ma ti ya/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse 'a chen 'a' 'a ya thung ngu 'a' 'a ya chen po/ 'a' 'a ya thung ngu 'a nus pa'i stobs/ /gcig la bsdus 'a' 'a ya thung ngu 'a' 'a ya chen po 'a' 'a ya thung ngu 'a ngag srog 'deg 'gyur gi dbang 'deg 'a phyug 'a'a'a'a'a'a' kun dga'i bstan/ /spel la mdzad 'degs 'gyur 'a blo gros srog 'degs 'gyur mtshungs 'byed 'degs 'a med 'a'a'a'a'a'a' sangs rgyas kyi/

/bstan pa'i 'a'a'a'a'a'a' rgyal mtshan dpal 'a'a'a'a'a'a' rang bzhin ring bar thon bzang por 'dud/ /chos kyi rgyal dpal 'a ldan 'a'a' he ru ka 'deg /gdul 'a bya'i 'a'a' don du sa 'a mo 'a'a' zhi ba yi/ /dpyid yi zla 'a tha ma'i yar 'a ngo'i 'a'a' bcu gcig la/ /bltams gong bzhin 'a'a' pa nas bzung sprul 'a pa'i chen po sogs gong bzhin 'a'a' gnas mchog tu/ /chu yos snron zla phyi 'a shol gong bzhin 'a'a' tshes gnyis kyi/ /nyi 'a gros 'a'a' dus su zhi 'a bar 'a'a' gshegs kyi bar rab 'a tu 'a ngo mtshar rnam mthar 'a'a' rgya mtsho las/ /thigs 'a tsam 'a'a' 'chad la gus 'a pas nyan par gyis/ /thigs ge tsam 'a 'chad la gus 'a pas 'a chen 'a'a'a' ya chen po 'a'a'a' rang bzhin ring ba thin nyan par gyis/ /shes bya thams la cad gzigs 'a pa'i 'a'a' spyan 'gyogs yangs 'degs pa/ /'gro 'a kun 'a'a' dge legs sgrub pa'i thugs rje can/ /bsam ma yas phrin las mdzad 'a pa'i 'a'a' stobs mnga' ba/ /'jam 'a mgon 'a'a' bla ma'i zhabs 'a la 'a'a' mgos phyag mtshal/ /'jam 'a mgon 'a'a' bla ma'i zhabs 'a la 'a'a' mgos phyag 'tshal/ ༈ /gang gi mchod de'i rdzas pas zhing res khams ma rgya ga mtsho yi rdul lo snyed de sna ga tshogs 'a yi mchod pa'i sprin phung gi 'a ya rnam ma par ba rgyan nas sa yi rgyan nas gyis yas 'od do'i zer res phyogs ga bcur yi phro lo 'o yi 'a yi rtse mor rgya mtsho yi 'a ya rdul lo gyi ye grangs nga snyed de rin nas chen nas pad de mo'i rin nas chen nas 'od de sbyin nas kun nus nas ye 'a yi rgyas pa'i snying po la/ 'a ya lha ma dang mi 'e yi yi 'dod do'i yon nos rmad de 'di'i 'dod do'i dgu yi'i dpal la 'byung ngo bye ye ba ga 'a yi phrag brgya legs gnas pa/ 'a ya kun nus tu'o bzang nga po yi rnam ma 'phrul lo ji ye bzhin nas kun nus nas yas dge las ba yis sems mas kyis ye 'a ya sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di 'a ya chos yos dbyings nges ji ye bzhin nas nam mkha'i yi dbyings des kun nus la ba khyab ba cing des sems mas can nas 'a yi dbyings mtha' ji srid bar 'a ya rnam ma par ba gnas yas nas gnas chos yos kyi ye rgyal la po bo rgyal la ba yi rgyal la sras yas rang nga rgyal la 'a yi dgra las rnam rgyal bas/
